title: prunr.json
description: The configuration of prunr, the dead code detector.

$schema.description: The JSON Schema of this file, for editors.

baseline.description:
The baseline file, relative to the root: findings the project already had. They do not
fail the check, and `prunr baseline` rewrites the file.

Entries.description: Paths or globs, relative to the project root. In a glob, `*` does not cross `/` and `**` does.

production.description: Where the program starts. Everything they reach, directly or not, is alive.

test.description: Test code. It is never reported, and what only it reaches is dead in production.

Dependencies.description: How the dependency checks treat packages.

ignore.description:
Packages to leave out of the dependency checks: those only a command line uses (`jest`,
`husky`), or that are loaded in ways the graph cannot see.
